general.q: How far in advance should I book?
general.a: At least 2 weeks for single events, 4 weeks for retainer work.
We're Berlin-based. Nearby projects considered on request.

general.q: What formats do you deliver in?
general.a: Press JPEG selects in named folders + full-res finals, organized for immediate distribution.

general.q: Do you offer video as well as photo?
general.a: Yes. Both, or either, depending on scope.

concerts-events.q: How fast are same-night selects delivered?
concerts-events.a: Within a few hours of the show ending. In your inbox before morning.
We align on access during briefing. Most venues handle press credentials directly.

concerts-events.q: How many images are in a typical delivery?
concerts-events.a: 20–40 press selects + full gallery of finals, depending on scope.

exhibition-gallery.q: Do you shoot the opening and the installation?
exhibition-gallery.a: Both, or either — depending on your program and what you need for press and archive.

exhibition-gallery.q: Can images be used for funding applications?
exhibition-gallery.a: Yes. Files are organized exactly for that use — named, formatted, and press-ready.

exhibition-gallery.q: How long does a gallery shoot take?
exhibition-gallery.a: Typically 2–4 hours depending on the space and event.

artist-sessions.a: Your studio, a location of your choice, or we find the right space together.
Typically 2–3 hours. We align on scope and output during briefing.
Portrait set (press, web, album art framings) + process stills, organized by use.

brand-agency.a: For priority selects, yes. Timing is confirmed during briefing.

brand-agency.q: Can you work with our in-house creative team?
brand-agency.a: Yes. We align on brand direction and visual standards during the briefing call.
